title: cyclophyllum pancheri
intro: Cyclophyllum pancheri, commonly known as the Pancheri's wood, is a plant species native to the island of New Caledonia, belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cyclophyllum pancheri include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cyclophyllum pancheri are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
